requirement.description: Data validation is currently broken. That is simply how the validation setup works today.
requirement.reading: That is simply how the validation setup works today.

narrator.name: Data Dave
narrator.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something does not exist. Describe only how the work is done today without it, as observed events or numbers. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: The nightly ingestion pipeline pulls point of sale scan lines and stock on hand records into the staging area. There is no automated check to confirm that every store sent a complete file before the forecast job starts. The process waits for the configured timeout, then moves whatever arrived into the training set. If a regional distribution centre fails to transmit its data, the system proceeds with the missing entries. I observed this happen three times in the last month. In each case, the job logged a warning but continued execution without flagging the gap to the model team. The forecast ran on the partial dataset and produced output for the affected stores.
output.reclassify_reason: The text is a purely descriptive account of the current pipeline behavior, observed incidents, and lack of validation checks, without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs.
output.humor_archetype: A health check that asks the wrong question
